title: An-Nazi'at 79:33-40 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 32 (Pupil PDF worksheet: An-Nazi'at 79:33-40 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 32. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ (٣٣) فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ (٣٤) يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ (٣٥) وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ (٣٦) فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ (٣٧) وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا (٣٨) فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ (٣٩) وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ (٤٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
So as for he who transgressed
And preferred the life of the world,
Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Idgham with ghunnah: ن into ي
Written waw read as alif; sun letter د

questions.q: Chunk and link An-Nazi'at 79:33-40 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 79:33-40 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 79:33-40 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.
Transgressing and preferring this world leads to Hellfire; fearing Allah and restraining desires leads to Paradise.

questions.q: Find every madd lazim and muttasil in 79:33 to 40.
According to 79:40 to 41, who will have Paradise as refuge?
options: The one who feared his Lord and held back his desires
The one who preferred this world
questions.a: A) The one who feared his Lord and held back his desires. 79:40 to 41.

questions.q: An-Nazi'at 79:37: «فَأَمَّا مَن ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 'As for he who feared standing before his Lord and stopped his soul from its desires' (79:40). What desire might a teenager need to hold back?
questions.a: Anger, laziness in prayer, too much screen time, harmful words: holding back for Allah's sake.
